elevations.notes: Physical east to west: salmon Brummer14 (7upperaxes), yellow Remander16 (7axes perupperrow, middle3pediments, asymmetric currentground openings), offwhite Sederholm18 (7upperaxes, whitepilasters/balustrades). Street View plus official architectural photograph establish distinct layouts. Clear April2023 Brummer panorama resolves five shuttered ground windows and two doors (eastmost and centre); current asymmetric Remander ground is retained rather than copied from2005.

limitations: Only the north square-facing plane is restored. Long Katariinankatu west elevation, roofs and all courtyard wings retain their original municipal materials.
The source municipal mesh has no vertical central north Sederholm gable above its flat eave. A material chart cannot recreate the missing projecting pediment; it is not painted over the top windows.
Window and masonry dimensions are original authored approximations fitted to exact municipal source planes.
dimensions: Source plane bounds are exact municipal geometry; opening positions, dimensions and colours are authored approximations fitted to observed architectural rhythm. No survey accuracy is claimed.
